: science that studies the heritable regulation of gene expression without change in nucleotide sequence.
• Nutrigenetics: science that aims to study the effect of genetic variations on the interaction between diet and disease.
• Single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP): genetic variations in a single nucleotide at a speciﬁc position in the genome. These
variations are present in more than 1% of the general population.
